tof_core.description: A time-of-flight sensor's phase frames in, depth out: the four most recent reference phases to phase and amplitude, and phase to perpendicular depth in millimetres. For any four-phase sensor whose source counts its frames in the headers: which phase a frame carries is its place in the capture loop, read from that count; the sensor's phase order, its range and its optics arrive at run time, its samples' form at build. Made of generated blocks alone, it is proved from their models.

bit_depth.description: Depth the phase samples arrive at: the word each signed sample rides in.

max_width.description: Widest frame any sensor served may send: what the phase history keeps a frame of.

max_height.description: Tallest frame any sensor served may send.

frames.description: Frames the stream brings side by side, from a frame store upstream; 0: the phase history is kept here.

headroom.description: Bits of each sample's word above its sign, always zero: the sensor's samples are two's complement below them.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: One reference phase a frame, up to max_width x max_height at bit_depth, each frame's count in its header -- or, from a frame store, the four latest side by side. The context facts ride with the stream, latched at each frame's start, never registers.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: Two channels: [0] perpendicular depth in millimetres, zero where the amplitude fell below its threshold, [1] the amplitude. Width traced, not declared.

quad.description: The last four frames to phase and amplitude. The live frame's place in the capture loop is the low bits of its count: the source anchors its loop there.

range.description: Phase to perpendicular depth, below-threshold amplitude zeroed.
